name: CloudCLI
description: Web UI for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and OpenCode CLIs: chat, file editor, terminal and git in the browser.

install: npm ci --ignore-scripts && npm rebuild bcrypt better-sqlite3 esbuild node-pty sharp

(npm rebuild @vscode/ripgrep >/dev/null 2>&1 && test -x node_modules/@vscode/ripgrep/bin/rg) || (mkdir -p node_modules/@vscode/ripgrep/bin && ln -sf "$(command -v rg)" node_modules/@vscode/ripgrep/bin/rg)

printf '%s\n' 'import { defineConfig, mergeConfig } from "vite"' 'import base from "./vite.config.js"' 'export default defineConfig(async (env) => mergeConfig(await (typeof base === "function" ? base(env) : base), { server: { allowedHosts: true } }))' > vite.homemade.config.js

api.cmd: HOST=0.0.0.0 SERVER_PORT=3001 exec npm run server:dev

web.cmd: HOST=0.0.0.0 SERVER_PORT=3001 exec npx vite --config vite.homemade.config.js
